editorial:
Imagine working your whole life to be a good dad and provider, only to have the rug pulled out from under you. That is exactly what happens to Andrew. He is just a regular guy trying to do the right thing, but when his job vanishes, he hits rock bottom. You will feel for him as he gets lured into the dangerous world of drug running just to keep his head above water. The movie feels gritty and real, making you wonder if you would make the same bad choices if you were in his shoes.

The acting is solid and keeps you locked into the screen, though some parts of the story move a bit slow. The real draw is the mystery of Andrew's past that slowly comes to light. If you like crime stories with a lot of heart and a few big surprises, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: In the final act, you find out that Andrew's past is tied to the very people he is now working for. The big twist reveals that his family history was not what he thought, leading to a violent showdown. Andrew eventually manages to break free from the drug circle by outsmarting the villains. He loses a lot along the way, but he finally finds peace and secures a safe future for his children.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime dramas about ordinary people in bad situations.
